newsitem.title: USA: U.S. lawyer killed by helicopter blades.
newsitem.headline: U.S. lawyer killed by helicopter blades.

text.p: One of the highest-paid lawyers in the United States died in Indianapolis on Wednesday when he stepped out of a helicopter and was hit by the main rotor blade, safety officials said.
Lawrence Inlow, 46, a general counsel at Conseco Inc., a Carmel, Ind.-based insurer and financial services company, died as he left the helicopter at Indianapolis International Airport.
He got out as the pilot was shutting down the engine and was struck by the blade, according to the National Transportation Safety Board, which will investigate the accident.

"I was deeply saddened to learn of the death of Larry Inlow in an accident this morning. This is a devastating blow to everyone in the Conseco family," Conseco chief executive Stephen Hilbert said in a statement.
A company spokesman said Inlow, a Harvard Law School graduate, had a wife and seven children.
He was paid $12.8 million in 1996. In 1994, when his pay was $21.5 million, Forbes magazine ranked him as the eighth-highest paid lawyer in the United States.
